symptom: On /prijzen the pricing direction switch, monthly/yearly billing toggle and lifecycle phase pills rendered correctly but did not reliably change visible state when clicked; spacing between the direction switch and billing controls was also inconsistent.
root_cause: The pricing page depended on a single direct-listener initialization path for several independent control groups. When that runtime path was disrupted or a higher stacking context intercepted interaction, the controls still looked interactive while their state did not change.
Interactive groups did not share one delegated fallback event path, so there was no resilient recovery layer for clicks/taps after later page transforms.
The billing row used a negative top margin, which visually pulled it out of alignment with the price-direction switch.
fix: Added a delegated capture-phase interaction guard for price direction, lifecycle stage, billing period and refresh controls.
Synchronised hidden state, aria-selected/aria-pressed, keyboard tab navigation and checkout billing parameters.
Raised the interactive control groups into an isolated stacking context and removed the negative billing-row offset.
prevention: Pricing controls must remain operable through delegated event handling even if direct listeners fail or page transforms reorder runtime initialization.
Every pricing UI change must verify state transition semantics: selected/pressed state, hidden panel/card swap, price text change and checkout query update.
Do not use negative layout offsets to visually align stateful controls when normal flow can express the spacing.
evidence: PR #2655 changes prices.html only for the runtime and layout hardening plus this required closure lineage.

regression_contract: Price direction tabs switch visible card groups.
Monthly/yearly buttons change displayed recurring prices and billing query parameters.
Lifecycle phase buttons swap their corresponding panels.
Refresh buttons maintain one active/aria-pressed state.

historical_replay: The pre-fix pricing source contained all control markup and a syntactically valid direct-listener runtime, yet the user-observed page still failed to transition state. This reproduces the class of failure where render presence and syntax validity are insufficient evidence of interaction health.
candidate_checks: Delegated capture-phase click handling covers price direction, billing, lifecycle stages and refresh controls.
ARIA selected/pressed states are updated together with hidden card/panel state.
Monthly/yearly selection updates displayed recurring prices and checkout billing query parameters.
Interactive groups use explicit stacking/isolation and no longer rely on the negative billing-row offset.
evaluation.pass_condition: Exact-head website tests pass and production promotion/readback completes after merge; functional interaction must show visible state transitions on the public page.
